notes.title: Games of Winter Tournament Roundup
notes.content:
The Leadwerks 2016 Winter Games Tournament is complete!  This tournament brought some new types of games we haven't seen before, with a wide range of new games to try.  Here's a review.

[h1]The Adventures of Relic Rick[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/games/_/the-adventures-of-relic-rick-public-alpha-v100-r108

You control the adventurer, Rick, who is on a hunt for an ancient artifact for his museum. During his search in an underground ruin, he feels an earthquake and, before he knows it, the ground caves in beneath his feet! Rick is then swallowed into a secret temple! Trapped inside, Rick must proceed forward through the newly discovered ruin using his wits to solve puzzles, collect keys, and survive to escape the labyrinth. Will he ever find a way out of this secret underground dungeon or will it become his permanent tomb? It is up to you to help guide Rick out of his unfortunate state.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_02_2016/blogentry-1364-0-46105100-1456426242_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Sentinal Defect[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=625497837

Survive against waves of killer robot spiders, armed with an SMG and an endless supply of ammunition.  How many waves can you survive?  The visual design is simple but consistent and striking.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_02_2016/blogentry-1364-0-78670500-1456423581_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Present Hunt[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=629645154

Gather the presents and bring them to the tree.  Heavy post-processing effects and a rich atmosphere make this an environment worth exploring.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_02_2016/blogentry-1364-0-53745700-1456424516_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Dungeon Creeper[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=621811493

You're the pest-control snow-machine repair guy! Your career in life is to visit different places on your trusty boat and fix their machinery.

This winter, you've received a special call out to Snow Town - their snow machine has broken down and they need you to re-set it!

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_02_2016/blogentry-1364-0-49026000-1456423958_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]d4Shmup[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=630002481

An overhead shoot-em-up made with Leadwerks!  Pilot your ship through a short level blasting enemies in your path.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_02_2016/blogentry-1364-0-53201400-1456424118_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Hankinator's Ode to Alpha Dog[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=626762660

The Hankinator is back with another wacky game.  You are a dog air-dropped into a viking village on a mission to bite as many people as possible.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_02_2016/blogentry-1364-0-93308400-1456424244.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Lost and The Fallen[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=630028747

This interesting concept lets you lead your dog to locate a missing person.  Locate the missing individual with the help of your dog. Should be possible to 'complete' the first single level but only intended as very early demo.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_02_2016/blogentry-1364-0-18825900-1456424630_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Science Preview[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=605707281

This science fiction FPS pits you against an endless onslaught of terrifying monsters.  The level design is reminiscent of 1990's shooters.  Try it now!

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_02_2016/blogentry-1364-0-70209200-1456424682_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Maze Sweeper[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=630071001

From the author:
You have gotten captured by evil scientist trying to experement on you, when you find guns and a way out, you find a monster that has not became so crazy as the other monsters, and he knows the way through the maze to the teleporter, you hope he will last, but he may become crazy on the way out.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_02_2016/blogentry-1364-0-76644100-1456424954_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Nennerog[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=627877110

An experimental first-person shooter from first-time author lbxr2000.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_02_2016/blogentry-1364-0-87739500-1456425375_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]My Place[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=626851826

Explore the mountain base.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_02_2016/blogentry-1364-0-26471700-1456425431_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]3rd Person Controller[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=616558416

This tech demo lets you control a character in third-person view, with lots of level interactions to try.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_02_2016/blogentry-1364-0-55928300-1456425537_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Ice Island[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=610426359

While not strictly a game, this is an interesting environment to explore.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_02_2016/blogentry-1364-0-54782700-1456425842_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]ZombScar[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=615676471

Explore the surface of another planet.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_02_2016/blogentry-1364-0-60056400-1456425578_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Pong3D[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=603368404

Play the classic game "Pong" in a bright flashing futuristic 3D setting.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_02_2016/blogentry-1364-0-31501700-1456425918_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Recovery[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=613979230

A beginning game made with Workshop content, with a cool menu.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_02_2016/blogentry-1364-0-17033400-1456426070_thumb.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Halloween Game Tournament Roundup
notes.content:
The 2015 Leadwerks Halloween Game Tournament is complete, with results above and beyond any previous game tournament.  The quality, content, and fun of the lineup of games this tournament is really spectacular.

[h1]Halloween Pumpkin Run[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=540259470

If one game summed up the spirit of this year's tournament, it's this title.  The atmosphere, gameplay, and fun of this title make it an instance classic in the Leadwerks catalog of user-made games.

Try to collect all the pumpkins but beware the graveyard residents who don't like trespassers disturbing them. The more pumpkins you take the more dead will awaken!

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_11_2015/blogentry-1364-0-29852700-1446944089_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Siege (Download)[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/games/_/siege-r105

SIEGE is an RTS where two teams fight to be the last one standing. Once a combatant has been slain, it will turn into a zombie and fight anyone who is near him. Make sure YOU are the one standing in the end.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_11_2015/blogentry-1364-0-64888500-1446999046_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Island of Fear[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=534704938

You live in a small house on a fishing island, One day Henry has caught an unknown species successfully. As the people of Island of Fear no longer have big catch more had they had for fish to eat before had. Henry cut off it was over the campfire and test it. He gave the people clear and thought it tasted great! Everyone grabbed a piece and thought it was also very tasty. Since you do not trust the test fish, you took some bread to yourself and went to bed. In the night you wake up and can not trust your eyes.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_11_2015/blogentry-1364-0-77757700-1446944083_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Rolly: The Rollable Ball That Rolls To Much[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=535234474

A coding exercise done for the Halloween Game Tournament. It's not "Halloween-ish" but I think it's something else that will make you scream and curse out loud. I'll continue to update the project a little at a time until the Tournament ends.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_11_2015/blogentry-1364-0-68481300-1446944212_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Enter[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=537727897

Unless there's some hidden features, there's not much to do here, but kudos for publishing something!

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_11_2015/blogentry-1364-0-90013700-1446944263_thumb.png[/img]

[h1]WolfTale[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=543156064

This is my first game created with Leadwerks! It's an entry for the Halloween 2015 games contest. It's not overly polished, some parts I couldn't figure out (for example, setting the camera to NOT go through buildings!). Hope you enjoy it!

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_11_2015/blogentry-1364-0-98980800-1446944404_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]LEMaze[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=543617616

Game by shadmar for the Halloween Game Tournament 2015

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_11_2015/blogentry-1364-0-63316400-1446948252_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Cobra[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=546727133

A member of the Elite Cobra Squad has been dropped deep in enemy territory. It's just you and your trusty Sub Machine Gun... they are seriously out numbered.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_11_2015/blogentry-1364-0-08135100-1446948302_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Crazy Scorpion[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=547820610

Just a little concept level that was made for
Halloween Game Tournament

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_11_2015/blogentry-1364-0-59282400-1446948395_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Crawler Defense[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=548449469

A Tower Defense game , round based.
Please leave a comment , if you like !

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_11_2015/blogentry-1364-0-73800600-1446948450_thumb.jpeg[/img]

[h1]The Hankinator's House of Pain[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=548835676

Welcome to The Hankinator's House of Pain!

This is my entry for the Halloween game tournament. A game of survival, kill enemies to get points, spend points to buy traps and weapons! Survive to the end! Higher difficulty yields more points!

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_11_2015/blogentry-1364-0-02364500-1446948494_thumb.jpg[/img]

[b]Noteworthy Additions[/b]
The following games were not published strictly within the tournament timeframe, but deserve additional mention.

[h1]Marblez[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=549467145

This is a game I have been working on for a while. I started it with a Summer Game Competition entry, and have integrated many new features into it. I intentionally waited for after the halloween game competiton to end before posting this.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_11_2015/blogentry-1364-0-87986600-1446948604_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Borrower[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=527801322

Escape the dungeon using your power to control the elements.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_11_2015/blogentry-1364-0-97574300-1446948654_thumb.jpg[/img]

Prize will be sent out by mail shortly.  This tournament brings our count of Leadwerks Games playable on Steam to 40.  Together with recent updates in the Workshop system, we're nearly ready to make a final release of Leadwerks Game Launcher.
